services.name: Adult Tours
services.desc: Mazza offers one educational conference each year for librarians, teachers and book lovers alike. You’ll delight in engaging keynote presentations from the top authors and illustrators in the industry and benefit from the opportunity to network with peers. Schedule an informative one hour guided tour where you’ll learn about the history of the museum, the artwork in the teaching units, educational programming and museum preservation. Mazza offers the opportunity for educators and librarians from primary, elementary, or secondary schools to participate in workshops for professional development.
